description: This file defines the ProviderSettingsManager class responsible for managing provider configurations, including loading, saving, migrating, and synchronizing provider profiles, with support for cloud profile synchronization and migration handling.

classes.name: ProviderSettingsManager
classes.description: Manages provider configurations, including loading, saving, migration, and cloud profile synchronization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Waits for the completion of initial migration and setup tasks.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Ensures serialized execution of async operations.

methods.name: init_runMigrations
methods.description: Performs initial migration and setup of provider profiles.

methods.name: migrateRateLimitSeconds
methods.description: Migrates rate limit settings from global state to provider configs.

methods.name: migrateDiffSettings
methods.description: Migrates diff settings from global state to provider configs.

methods.name: migrateOpenAiHeaders
methods.description: Migrates OpenAI header settings.

methods.name: migrateConsecutiveMistakeLimit
methods.description: Migrates mistake limit settings.

methods.name: migrateTodoListEnabled
methods.description: Migrates todo list enabled setting.

methods.name: applyModelMigrations
methods.description: Applies model ID migrations to provider configs.

methods.name: cleanModelId
methods.description: Removes prefix before '/' in model ID.

methods.name: listConfig
methods.description: Lists all provider configurations with metadata.

methods.name: validateAutocompleteConstraint
methods.description: Ensures only one autocomplete profile exists.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves a provider configuration with a given name.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by name or ID.

methods.name: activateProfile
methods.description: Activates a profile by name or ID.

methods.name: deleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes a profile by name.

methods.name: hasConfig
methods.description: Checks if a profile exists by name.

methods.name: setModeConfig
methods.description: Sets the API config for a specific mode.

methods.name: getModeConfigId
methods.description: Gets the API config ID for a specific mode.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports provider profiles with filtering based on model support.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Imports provider profiles.

methods.name: resetAllConfigs
methods.description: Resets all provider configs by deleting secrets.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads provider profiles from secrets storage.

methods.name: sanitizeProviderConfig
methods.description: Sanitizes provider config by resetting invalid apiProvider values.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores provider profiles into secrets storage.

methods.name: findUniqueProfileName
methods.description: Finds a unique profile name based on a base name.

methods.name: syncCloudProfiles
methods.description: Synchronizes cloud profiles with local provider profiles, handling additions, updates, and deletions.
